rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something suitable, appropriate, or fitting.

example.english: This time is apt for us to have the meeting.
example.traditional: 呢個時間好啱我哋開會。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 gaan1 hou2 ngaam1 ngo5 dei6 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this pattern when someone or something is liable or prone to do what follows the verb.

example.english: In winter, the windows are apt to fog up.
example.jyutping: dung1 tin1 di1 bo1 lei1 jung4 ji6 hei2 mou6

rows.note: Use this when apt means capable or quick to learn, especially when describing a person.

example.english: They are apt at learning new things and understand after one lesson.
example.traditional: 佢學新嘢真係好叻，一教就識。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hok6 san1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 jat1 gaau3 zau6 sik1
